number.why: The served HR 0.76 (95% CI 0.62 to 0.93) correctly reproduces the abstract's all-cause mortality estimate, but does not establish the requested longest randomized follow-up. The abstract reports premature stopping after median follow-up of 21 months; the registry distinguishes cut-off mortality counts from later complete double-blind counts. Absence of a separately reported complete-phase HR does not justify confirming the earlier HR for that later timepoint. A replacement longest-follow-up HR cannot be established from this packet.

quotes.span: The trial was stopped prematurely, according to prespecified rules, after a median follow-up period of 21 months.

entry.why: The sources establish an adult population with reduced-ejection-fraction heart failure randomized to eplerenone or placebo in a double-blind trial, satisfying the packet's question.

quotes.span: In this randomized, double-blind trial, we randomly assigned 2737 patients with New York Heart Association class II heart failure and an ejection fraction of no more than 35% to receive eplerenone (up to 50 mg daily) or placebo, in addition to recommended therapy.
ELIGIBILITY AGE/SEX: minimum age 55 Years | maximum age None | sex ALL

missed: The ruling acknowledges the later complete double-blind mortality counts but fails to enforce the served timepoint. The quoted registry measurements establish distinct follow-up windows; confirming the abstract's number does not establish its applicability to the longest window.
